about_short_description.short_description: Fortis is a one-stop POS and CRM solution that enables small service to accept offline and online point-of-sale payments.

product.name: SmartPOS
product.description: A point-of-sale system that runs on a card machine and cloud platform for taking orders, accepting card and cash payments, managing customers, inventory, and sales.

product.name: Fortis One
product.description: A unified POS and business management platform that synchronizes sales, orders, products, customers, inventory, and reporting across locations and sales channels.

product.name: Table Pay
product.description: A restaurant and café payment solution that lets guests view QR menus, split bills, add tips, and pay by phone, while staff can manage tables and accept card or cash payments.

product.name: Fortis Loyalty
product.description: A digital loyalty program that issues points or stamps, records customer activity, and sends promotional notifications through a mobile app or POS-integrated card machine.

product.name: AI Agents
product.description: An AI-assisted business insight service that uses real-time operational data to help businesses analyze performance and make decisions.

product.name: Food and Beverage Solutions
product.description: A packaged POS and payment solution for food and beverage businesses covering orders, tables, QR menus, payments, tips, reviews, and operational reporting.
